name: Zonal Board – 2 relays to give zonal alarm per zone for the CFP 2 zones
family: Context Plus CFP Conventional Panel (LPCB Approved)
summary: An optional system expansion device for use with Context Plus CFP702-4 Standard 2 Zone Fire Panels.
features: Provides two output per zone relays which will changeover when the corresponding zone is in alarm (subject to certain conditions – for full details refer to the instructions, downloadable below).
PCB mounts inside the Context Plus CFP fire panel.
Outputs are NOT designed to switch mains voltages.
